detail_zh.lead: 绸面写真相纸适用于希望呈现柔和表面效果的海报、促销画面和展示项目。
highlights: 默认使用爱普生兼容替代墨水；爱普生原装墨水可选，按订单确认
默认覆100gsm PVC冷裱膜，黄底离型纸；可选亮膜或哑膜
finishing: 默认100gsm PVC冷裱膜（黄底离型纸），可选亮膜或哑膜
默认卷装并使用硬质纸筒包装
覆膜材料本身具有高透明、低气味、耐水、耐腐蚀、耐磨、耐刮擦及抗UV等特性；这些描述针对覆膜材料，不代表成品具有未经测试的户外使用寿命。
delivery: 西安同城（以确认下单时间为准）：11:00 前下单当天下午送达，19:00 前次日中午前送达，19:00 后次日下午送达
三环内必达，三环外多数郊区可达；自有封闭式面包车专送，卷材整卷送货上门
江浙沪皖由浙江嘉兴海盐合作工厂发货；其他地区时效按订单确认
标准包装：卷装，内置硬质纸筒；具体包装形式可按订单确认
detail_zh.artwork: 请提供印刷文件、成品尺寸、数量、卷装或裁切要求及目的地。生产前可核对文件尺寸和出血设置。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供材料类型、宽度、数量或面积、是否覆膜、油墨选择、包装要求及收货国家/地区。
detail_zh.caveat: 本页未列具体起订量与价格：这些参数按每笔订单的实际规格确认，询价时请注明所需规格。运费、税费及最终交付时间需按目的地和运输方案确认。需要发票可代开，确认订单时说明即可。

detail_en.lead: Satin photo paper is suited to posters, promotional graphics and displays where a softer surface appearance is preferred.
highlights: Epson-compatible replacement ink is standard; original Epson ink is available on request, confirmed per order
Standard cold lamination uses 100 gsm PVC film with a yellow release liner; gloss or matte finish available
finishing: Standard 100 gsm PVC cold lamination with yellow release liner; gloss or matte finish
Standard roll packing with a rigid paper tube inside

The lamination film itself is described as highly transparent, low-odour, water-resistant, corrosion-resistant, abrasion-resistant, scratch-resistant and UV-resistant. These properties describe the film, not an untested outdoor service life for the finished print.
delivery: Production and dispatch timing confirmed per order
Sea freight to Australian main ports is around 40 days as a reference
Photos of the finished graphics and the export packing are sent for your confirmation before dispatch
Standard packing: rolls on a rigid paper tube; alternative packing can be confirmed per order
detail_en.artwork: Please provide print-ready artwork, finished dimensions, quantity, roll or cut-sheet requirements and destination. File dimensions and bleed can be checked before production.
detail_en.brief: Please specify the media type, width, quantity or area, lamination, ink option, packing requirements and destination country or region.
detail_en.caveat: Minimum order quantity and pricing are not listed on this page: they are confirmed against the actual specification of each order, so please state your required specification when enquiring. Freight, duties and final delivery dates must be confirmed for the destination and shipping arrangement.
